scope: Native iGap laboratory publication ordering; offline lifecycle tests followed by one bounded parent-run real default-start trial

facts: engine.addTrack registers an exact-CID resolver before sendAddTrack and rejects it after 10000 ms without TrackPublished
onLocalTrackPublished resolves only the matching pending CID with the returned TrackInfo
The empty enabledPublishVideoCodecs branch awaits addTrack before sender creation and negotiation
The nonempty enabledPublishVideoCodecs branch can negotiate concurrently with addTrack; ACK-before-offer is therefore supported SDK ordering, not a universal LiveKit requirement

priorLiveEvidence.independentImmediateStartup: Failed; one publisher remained unobserved, and service reported ConnectionTimeout
priorLiveEvidence.sharedControllerDeferredStartup: Previously succeeded with mutual authentication and exact HTTPS transfer bytes

deadlineCovers: publisher offer creation and local SDP
implementation.signalLoop: Consumes events while publication waits, including real subscriber Offer/Answer and early ICE
implementation.ackValidation: Exact pending local CID, TrackInfo present, nonempty bounded track SID, Audio type
implementation.cleanup: Cancelled or failed startup closes both PCs concurrently and uses an explicit local I/O abort hook; a pending-stream guard also aborts I/O if cancellation occurs before Join/Reconnect response adoption. Normal graceful SignalClient.close behavior is unchanged

cases: real subscriber SDP answer while publisher waits
publication timeout and cancellation close socket
default false path negotiates without ACK
silent WebSocket peer cannot prevent local task abort
abort interrupts an already waiting graceful close
both actual PCs close on abandoned startup
cancellation before Join adoption aborts already active I/O tasks
validation.parentLiveTest: One ordinary independent native-start trial without --defer-media succeeded: both peers authenticated; HTTPS download352240B and upload71680B had exact expected hashes. Details in native-endpoint-live-evidence-2026-11-04.json.
validation.vendorSignalClientTestMode: Exact vendor src/lib.rs via E-only temporary manifest with the same active Tokio/TLS dependencies; direct standalone offline manifest was blocked by uncached disabled async-tungstenite metadata. No dependency downloads or source copies.

limits: One single-host ordinary independent iGap startup and authenticated transfer succeeded after this correction. It does not establish the unique cause of prior failures, sustained performance, long-running reconnect, foreign VPS operation, billing or production integration.
